Privacy Policy

Your account. We store your username, display name, recovery email and profile so you can log in on any device.

Your chats. Messages, photos, voice notes and files you send are stored so they can be delivered to the people you chat with. Group messages are visible to group members.

Your calls. Voice calls connect you live with the other person. Call audio is not recorded or stored.

Your recovery email is used only to send password-reset codes and the welcome email. It is never shared or sold.

Your password is stored only as a secure hash. Nobody can read it, including us.

No ads. We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.

How long we keep things. Notifications are deleted after 7 days. Security alerts (logins, password changes, failed login attempts) are deleted after 25 days. Photos and videos you send in one-to-one and group chats are deleted completely 25 days after you send them. Exception: photos and videos you send to yourself in Message yourself are NOT auto-deleted — they stay until you delete them yourself. Text messages stay until you delete them. Stories disappear after 24 hours.

You are in control. You can delete your messages and chats at any time, and you can remove your recovery email in Settings.

🎮 My games

Start a game from any 1-to-1 chat — attach menu → Games — or from a group chat — header ⋮ menu → Games. One game room at a time: other live games stay here and in their invite cards.
